activation_gate.decision: Do not install, train, reconstruct, cluster, promote, or compare STAGATE in v1.
activation_gate.minimum_future_evidence: A rights-cleared powered donor-level spatial RNA source, memory-safe section-blocked adapter, registered transductive or frozen endpoint, strong baselines, and external evaluation.
activation_gate.task_gate: Keep target-fitted spatial domain discovery distinct from frozen held-donor prediction.

gse192741.native_fit: Visium RNA and coordinates are native in principle.
gse192741.why: Four donors, exposed outcomes, and unresolved hg19 annotation preclude a model claim.

gse292268.native_fit: Spatial expression and coordinates are structurally compatible, but panel depth and cell-level resolution require a separate stratum.

hra007511.native_fit: Visium RNA is native; H&E and adjacent-section MALDI are not inputs.

vu2025.native_fit: Visium RNA is native; CODEX and H&E are not model inputs.

graph_and_donor_firewall.two_dimensional: Construct one graph per participant and section or core, then combine block-diagonally. All sections from one participant stay in one fold.
graph_and_donor_firewall.three_dimensional: Disabled by default. It requires same-participant adjacent RNA sections, authoritative order and registration, physical Z spacing, and a precommitted cross-section objective.
graph_and_donor_firewall.query: Official STAGATE retrains on the target and is transductive. A frozen lane cannot refit encoder, graph hyperparameters, PCA, mclust, cluster count, or calibration.
graph_and_donor_firewall.replication: Participants are replicates; spots, nodes, edges, sections, and reconstructed values are not.

preprocessing_and_output_firewall.training_only: Normalization, log transform, HVGs, feature order, graph radius or K, architecture, epochs, clusterer, number of clusters, and any reconstruction threshold.
preprocessing_and_output_firewall.reconstruction: Label reconstructed expression derivable_not_observed. Never substitute it for native counts or use spots as replicates for differential testing.
preprocessing_and_output_firewall.missingness: Unmeasured genes, permission blocks, absent assays, and failed joins remain explicit missing states rather than zeros.

interpretation: STAGATE is a strong future target-fitted spatial RNA baseline, not an inductive pretrained model. Its selected PyG implementation is MIT-licensed but lacks a complete runtime and checkpoint export, densifies expression, and includes an unsafe cross-section option unless topology is rigorously controlled. With no eligible task or hold back, it remains deferred.
